title: Is It Really Safe to Invest in the S&P 500 Right Now? History Offers a Clear Answer.
title_zh: 现在投资标准普尔 500 指数真的安全吗？历史给出了明确的答案。
summary: History actually offers two clear answers about whether to invest in the S&P 500 now.
summary_zh: 关于现在是否投资标普500指数，历史实际上提供了两个明确的答案。

title: This Trillion-Dollar AI Stock Offers Better Quantum Computing Exposure Than IonQ, Rigetti, or D-Wave at a Multi-Year Valuation Low
title_zh: 这支价值数万亿美元的 AI 股票在量子计算方面的表现优于 IonQ、Rigetti 或 D-Wave，且估值处于多年低位
summary: Microsoft offers a lower-risk way to invest in the future of quantum computing by combining established AI and cloud leadership with an advancing quantum platform.
summary_zh: 微软将成熟的人工智能和云领先地位与先进的量子平台相结合，提供了一种风险较低的方式来投资量子计算的未来。

title: Paramount Skydance (PSKY) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut As Deal Risk Clouds Analyst Views
title_zh: 交易风险笼罩分析师观点，派拉蒙 Skydance (PSKY) 股票公允价值下跌
summary: The modeled fair value for Paramount Skydance has been cut from US$11.79 to US$10.12, which reflects a reduction of about 14% in the price target embedded in the latest assumptions.
summary_zh: Paramount Skydance 的模型公允价值已从 11.79 美元下调至 10.12 美元，反映出最新假设中的目标价格下降了约 14%。

title: Blackstone (BX) Leads Kuwait Deal And AI Backing, Is The Upside Already Priced In?
title_zh: Blackstone (BX) 引领科威特交易和人工智能支持，上涨空间是否已被消化？
summary: Blackstone (BX) is back in focus after leading a consortium in a $16,000 million lease and leaseback agreement with Kuwait Oil Company, alongside fresh backing of AI data center firm Firmus. See our latest analysis for Blackstone.
summary_zh: Blackstone (BX) 在带领一个财团与科威特石油公司签订了价值 160 亿美元的租赁和回租协议后，在人工智能数据中心公司 Firmus 的最新支持下，重新成为人们关注的焦点。请参阅我们对黑石的最新分析。

title: EasyJet agrees to £5.7bn takeover
title_zh: 易捷航空同意以 57 亿英镑收购
summary: EasyJet has agreed to a deal to sell the airline for around £5.7bn ($7.7bn) to a US-based investment firm.
summary_zh: EasyJet 已同意达成协议，以约 57 亿英镑（77 亿美元）的价格将该航空公司出售给一家美国投资公司。
